body.p: So. There lived two men. Two men, â¦ One of them is Enets. And the other one, people say, is an Evenki. Both of them shamans. Both of them shamans. Of course, they boasted among one another all the time. One of them said. If I want. I will eat you just now. And the other one also said. If I want. You will see, I will terminate you, I will eat you. Then. The Enets said. Maybe if we continue so, it will be bad, we. If we continue so, it will be bad, he said. For us, he said, it would be fine to fly away to the land of geese. Let' muster our strength well there. That's why we will muster our strength, he said, we cannot live on this land. So. There, he said, at some time, having mustered our strength, we will come to our land. And the two. Of the two shamans one lives in one place, the other one lives in another place. The Enets shaman said to his wife. Me, he said, I will move now to the land of the geese. In the middle of the geese. I will move to the land of the geese, and when the weather becomes spring, make me a tent. Make me a tent, he said. Make me a tent, he said. Having separated, he said, a clean tent for me. Anyway, if I am alive, he said, I will sit down in the tent. Well, his wife said, what. When you come, if you come alive, of course. And the other one, the Evenki shaman, also said to his wife. We, he said, will move now to the land of the geese. We cannot live on this land, he said. To one another. My mate said: I will eat you. Yes, and I already said to the mate: I will eat you. The Enets said, said so. It would be fine, he said, if we go to the land of the geese, to the place where the geese are. So. Then the Enets. The Enets â¦ had a tent for his rites. He has a tent â¦ At some time his wife saw him, when the evening came. She saw him, she said â¦ The Enets, he said, flew away from the tent. He flew away, he said, evidently he became a swan. He became a swan. The Enets left so, he said. So, he said. He appeared above the tent of his mate. He appeared above the tent of his mate. The Enets said so, well. That's enough, he said, prepare! Prepare, he said, I left to the land of the geese! (â¦). So the Evenki shaman says. Some time later he put on the dress for the rites. He was sitting and flew away through the flue. He said. A swan â¦ he became, well, he became an ember-goose, he said. Looking to the ember-geese, he cried out before leaving. What, he said so to the inhabitants of the tent, he said. Make a tent for me when I will come! Then the Enets. These shamans flew away, he said, to the land of the geese. And in the land of the geese, so, he said, a goose, geese are on the big water. There are a lot of birds. They joined there, he said. Then he said. We will shed our feathers, after all, like our mates. The swan then. The swan, then, well, is among his mates swans. And the ember-goose is among his mates ember-geese. And the ember-geese â¦ well. Yes, they fish. Some of them, he said, are there. There were, apparently, people there who fished. Some of them, he said, fall into the net. They fell into nets. And, well. And the ember-goose, he said, cannot shed feathers, his feathers did not fall, they were solid. So he always wears feathers. And the swan, he said, at some time. At some time, he said, his wings came off. His feathers fell down. The swan, he said, is without the wings. And the ember-goose jumps. It fishes. He finds his mate. He will say to his mate. He will say to his Enets mate. You said: I surpass you, I will surpass you! Yes. I can eat you. The swan said. And me, and me, he said, that's why so. I don't want, after all, he said, I freeze, after all. The swan said: I freeze. You see, he said, I have no feathers. Yes, he said, my clothes fell down. And you, he said, your clothes are solid. Yes. Your clothes are solid, he said, you move in the water. But don't leave so, he said. At some time, he said, don't fell into the sky net! If you fall there, he said, you will stay on this land. Nom, he said, yes, well. The ember-goose said. Why will I leave, he said. Yes, all the same, he said, I will leave home somehow. Then. The ember-goose said while fishing. â¦ he fell down into the installed nets, after all. So, he said, people caught him, after all. And the swan, although he froze. The clothing, at the time he said his new clothing appeared. And the ember-goose, he said, is still caught by the people. When his new clothing appeared the swan said. The spring weather came. As for now, now it seems to be warm. It would be fine if I go to my land. And the swan still says. He reached home, after all. He flew into the tent through the flue. He flew around it for some time. He sings like a swan. At some time his wife jumped outdoors. She said. Maybe this one came according to his words? And then the swan. The Enets, he said, sat down into this tent. Having sat down into the tent he said. All his clothes for the rites, his tambourines were there. So the sound of his tambourine appeared. At some time he quieted down. Having quieted down, he, well. His mates started asking him. As for you, you have come, after all, but where is your mate? My mate, he said, is in the land where I have gone, in the land where I have gone, at the sea. He fell into the nets. I don't know if he will be released. Oh, some people said. The one who fell into the nets, they said, how will he come? No. This swan, said the Enets. In my opinion, he said. As for his arrival, yes, he will come, he said. He will come, he said. So, he said, he belongs to the clan of the strong birds. That's the clan of the ember-geese. Its name, he said, its name will be the ember-goose. This, he said will be a bird like an iron. Yes. And me, he said. I came with one's last ounce, after all, he said. As for me, he said, I will leave so soon. Such â¦, he said. My clan will feed any inhabitant of the Earth. And the clan of the ember- geese, he said. So in the future nobody will catch it in vain. And now, he said, there in, well. He fell into the sky net in the â¦ land, he said. That's all. Henceforth, he said, wait for your ember-goose! Yes. In the Evenki clan, he said. In the Evenki clan, he said, him. People started praying to it, he said. And as for me, any inhabitant of the Earth will catch me.
